provenance.geometry: authored procedurally in Blender by these scripts; no third-party or generated meshes
provenance.textures: bark, foliage atlas (true alpha, colour-dilated) and gradient palette drawn with numpy in botany_lib.py; no AI imagery, no downloads
provenance.species_claim: readable garden forms; no claim of scientific species identity

instancing_contract.structure: root empty <species_id> -> one mesh node <species_id>_mesh (identity transform, <= 2 primitives) + anchor empties; build one InstancedMesh per (species, LOD, primitive, spatial cell)
instancing_contract.wind: wind_root / wind_sway / wind_tip empties on every species and LOD; extras carry profile, amplitude, frequency, stiffness and the weight rule; no extra vertex attributes (no COLOR_0, which three.js would multiply into base colour)
instancing_contract.alpha: only "Foliage • alpha-tested atlas" is MASK (cutoff 0.5) + doubleSided; use alphaTest, never transparent sorting; shadow casters need a depth material with the same alphaTest

assets.name: canopy-olive
assets.alpha_strategy: LOD0 + LOD1 alpha-tested sprig/cluster cards (MASK 0.5, double-sided, colour-dilated atlas); trunk and branches are geometry

pivot.origin: soil contact under the stem/trunk centre (vine: top attachment point)

anchors.name: wind_root
anchors.note: zero-motion pivot (soil contact / attachment)
anchors.wind_weight_rule: weight = smoothstep(0, 1, (y - wind_root.y) / (wind_tip.y - wind_root.y)); offset = amp * weight^2

anchors.name: wind_sway
anchors.note: primary sway pivot (trunk top / clump centre)
anchors.wind_weight_rule: weight = smoothstep(0, 1, (y - wind_root.y) / (wind_tip.y - wind_root.y)); offset = amp * weight^2

anchors.name: wind_tip
anchors.note: height of full-amplitude motion
anchors.wind_weight_rule: weight = smoothstep(0, 1, (y - wind_root.y) / (wind_tip.y - wind_root.y)); offset = amp * weight^2

anchors.name: anchor_soil_contact
anchors.note: origin; set on the soil/bed surface. Root flare / stems sink up to 0.10 m below it

anchors.name: anchor_crown_base
anchors.note: lowest foliage at scale 1.0; scale >= 2.3 / this keeps 2.3 m headroom at the drip line

collision.note: trunk only; crown base is above head height (see crown_base_m)

source_blend.contains: LOD0 + collision proxy; LOD1 is regenerated by the script

lod_switch.note: distance at fov 58 for scale 1; scale the threshold by instance scale
